gloss: long period of time; extended duration

definitions.gloss: long period of time; extended duration
definitions.explanation: A prolonged stretch of time, typically weeks, months, or years.

examples.japanese: {長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be away for a long period.

examples.japanese: {長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations continued over an extended period.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Taking this medicine for a long period may cause side effects.

notes:
{長|ちょう} (long) + ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period of time). Describes a stretch of time that is notably longer than usual, typically ranging from several weeks to years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる — over a long period
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦{放置|ほうち}する→放置する：25382_houchisuru⟧ — leave unattended for a long time
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — store for a long period
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}⟦{滞在|たいざい}する→滞在する：26834_taizaisuru⟧ — stay for an extended period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧ — long-term; focuses on the nature of something rather than the duration itself
- {長い間|ながいあいだ} — for a long time; more colloquial and conversational
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧ — many years; specifically implies years rather than a general long period
